title: The Red Badlands
changes: A new land lies beyond Oakvale's west edge: the Red Badlands, red mesas, stone arches and dry riverbeds, the homeland of the Redfang.
Take the Red Pass between Mirror Pond and the Barrow Downs. It opens for heroes of level 25 and above.
The badlands are quiet for now: Rustwater Post, its monsters and quests are on the way.
Your explored map is now saved in a much smaller form, so heroes with many characters no longer run out of map storage.
